status: Method proposal; no CFD or solver execution performed by reviewer
recommended_label: ANSYS shell conduction coupled to a well-mixed ventilation energy balance

scope.target: Conditional bulk internal-air and PLA-shell temperatures versus net fresh-air flow and total enclosed heat
scope.conservatism: Omitting lid/radiation cooling reduces modeled heat escape, but perfect air mixing can underpredict local hot spots. The combined model is not a guaranteed conservative temperature bound.

assumptions.fan: Installed fan-4007 operates continuously, per user. Manufacturer, rated voltage, pressure-flow curve and installed fresh-air exchange remain unknown.
assumptions.flow_interpretation: Analyst-selected scenarios, not installed-fan measurements or guaranteed bounds. Net fresh-air exchange excludes internal recirculation. Zero means no net fresh-air exchange, not necessarily a stopped fan.
assumptions.heat_interpretation: Analyst what-if totals dissipated inside enclosure, including fan/controller/converter losses without double counting. Do not label as measured idle/normal/heavy modes. Baseline deposits all heat into the well-mixed air; direct component contact to PLA is omitted.
assumptions.film_interpretation: Assigned independent sensitivities, not calculated from fan flow. No universal one-to-one mapping from CFM to film coefficient.
assumptions.air_property_interpretation: Constant approximate room-temperature, sea-level dry-air values; recompute if temperature/pressure departure becomes substantial.

preferred_linear_basis_method.step1: Solve actual shell mesh with zero heat generation, outside air at 25 C, inside well-mixed bulk air at 26 C, assigned inside/outside film coefficients and existing provisional PLA conductivity.
preferred_linear_basis_method.step2: Integrate outside convection Qshell. Since the air-to-ambient difference is 1 K, define Gshell=Qshell/(1 K). Independently integrate inside convection and confirm equal and opposite heat.
preferred_linear_basis_method.step3: Define Gvent=rho*cp*Qfresh with Qfresh in m3/s. For total heat P, solve DeltaTair=P/(Gshell+Gvent).
preferred_linear_basis_method.step4: For every shell node, Tnode=Tambient+(Tnode_basis-25 C)*DeltaTair/(1 K). This is exact for the stated linear boundary model with constant k and h.
preferred_linear_basis_method.energy_audit: P=Gvent*DeltaTair+Gshell*DeltaTair. Also independently reintegrate scaled shell convection. Never fix inside air at ambient while claiming it receives all component heat.
preferred_linear_basis_method.benefit: Requires few direct ANSYS solves; all airflow/heat/ambient sweeps follow mathematically without confusing numerical sweep points with additional CFD solves.

simultaneous_apdl_option.description: SURF152 inner-surface elements with one common extra TEMP node represent the unknown well-mixed air. An ambient TEMP node and LINK33 conductance k*A/L=rho*cp*Qfresh represent ventilation sensible heat. Apply F,airnode,HEAT,P. External wall convection uses fixed room ambient.
notes: Use noncoincident LINK33 nodes, SECTYPE/SECDATA area and material KXX in consistent MKS units.
At Qfresh=0 omit the ventilation link; shell path still grounds air temperature.
Ensure reciprocal wall/air energy exchange with SURF152 is retained. Verify small test before relying on extra-node formulation.
This is a thermal network representation; LINK33 does not solve fluid momentum or pressure.
Avoid duplicate convection on inner faces and heat-flux/convection conflicts on the same SURF152 element.

required_validation: Verify all active solid elements retain PLA conductivity and dimensions are MKS in exported solver input.
Check actual interior/exterior face sets, area and spatial position; prior face count or names alone are insufficient.
For basis solution check temperatures stay between prescribed air temperatures within numerical tolerance.
Independent inner/exterior heat integrals balance within a stated numerical tolerance.
Repeat at least representative basis on finer mesh; earlier heat-flux mesh convergence does not automatically prove the new boundary case.
For sensitivity results verify P=ventilation heat+exterior shell heat, temperatures decrease as fresh-air exchange increases at fixed films, and P=0 yields ambient.
If inferred temperatures approach PLA softening or assumptions become implausible, label them as breakdown/review scenarios; do not infer physical steady shape or safety.

primary_sources.supports: Comparison manufacturer 40x40x7 mm family lists 5 V and 12 V variants, maximum airflow 3.14 to 5.37 CFM. It does not identify the installed Stairio fan or its actual enclosure flow.
Fan delivered flow depends on static pressure/system impedance. Maximum catalogue flow corresponds to zero static pressure, so free-air flow must not be used as measured enclosure flow.

2025 R2 surface element has optional extra TEMP node for bulk temperature, convection coefficient via SFE, and one-extra-node KEYOPT(5)=1. One surface element face accepts convection or heat flux, not both simultaneously.

2025 R2 two-node thermal conduction link uses temperature DOFs, longitudinal KXX and section area, and must have nonzero length. Its energy-equivalent use for ventilation is the analyst's reduced-order model.
